info.name: Get the field tracking data for a specific play.

params.name: gamePk
params.description: Unique Primary Key Representing a Game

params.name: guid
params.description: Unique identifier for a play within a game

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma delimited list of specific fields to be returned. Format: topLevelNode, childNode, attribute

items.docs:
Returns a json file containing raw coordinate data and refined calculated metrics.

This responses can be very large, so it is strongly recommended that you pass "Accept-Encoding: gzip" as a header to have the responses compressed.

params.description: If there was a hit ball tracked

params.name: isPickoff
params.description: If there was a pickoff

params.name: hasUpdates
params.description: True if updated by an auditor
